about: Dated rechecks of Call Sheet calls against their official pages. 'changed' dates replace the research pack's; 'confirmed' dates only add times and zones. Unreachable pages are recorded but earn no 'Rechecked' mark.
method: Each official page was read on the day given; every date is backed by a quote in 'evidence'.
